abs_reaction_time.definition: The time between seeing a hazard and moving the brake pedal.
abs_reaction_time.example: The reaction time of the driver is part of the distance the car travels before the brakes work.

dinosaur.definition: An animal that lived a very long time ago, long before people. Dinosaurs are gone now, but their bones turn to stone under the ground.
dinosaur.example: The long-necked dinosaur pulled leaves from the treetop.

dream.definition: The story your brain makes while you sleep. Some people remember them, most do not.
dream.example: I had a strange dream about a talking bicycle.

ethnocentrism.definition: Judging another culture by the standards of your own, and reading every difference as a mistake.
ethnocentrism.example: Calling a local custom rude is ethnocentrism, not an observation.

linear_equation.definition: An equation that can be written as ax + b = 0, with a not equal to zero.
linear_equation.example: 2x + 3 = 11 is a linear equation in one unknown.

lsc_approach_avoidance.definition: The state in which the same goal pulls you towards it and away from it at the same time.
lsc_approach_avoidance.example: The approach-avoidance conflict is inside him, not in the other person.

mon_devaluation.definition: The act of lowering the value that other people attach to a person's work or judgement.
mon_devaluation.example: The devaluation was quiet: every meeting began with a small doubt about her work.

shallow_knowledge.definition: Familiarity with the surface of many topics without understanding of how any of them works.
